readings.Aries: Rest is not retreat. Your system needs to cycle before it can perform at capacity again. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Taurus: Beauty is not frivolous to you — it's structural. Without it, you cannot function well. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Gemini: There are two kinds of curiosity — the kind that opens doors and the kind that avoids commitment. Know which you're using. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Cancer: Your memory holds things gently that others would have dropped. Today that gift is needed. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Leo: The person you're becoming requires a different audience than the person you were. Update accordingly. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Virgo: Your willingness to work harder than necessary has served you. It has also cost you things. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Libra: There is something you find beautiful about someone that you haven't told them. Tell them. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Scorpio: The secret you're keeping is protecting someone. Including, in some ways, yourself. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Sagittarius: You are searching for a feeling you had once. It is not behind you. It is ahead, in a different form. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.
readings.Capricorn: Something you've dismissed as not yet achievable is closer than the plan shows. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Aquarius: There is someone who would surprise you if you let them. You haven't let them. Let them. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Pisces: You know the answer. You're waiting to know it more certainly. You won't. Trust what you already know. This is a better week for listening than speaking.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
